name: Unusual Whales Subversive Republican Trading ETF
blurb: The Unusual Whales Subversive Republican Trading ETF (GOP) is an exchange-traded fund that invests in stocks purchased or sold by Republican members of the U.S. Congress and their families. Launched on February 7, 2023, and issued by Subversive, the fund seeks to broadly track equity holdings of Republican lawmakers. As of May 2026, the ETF had a market cap of approximately $77.85 million and an expense ratio of 0.73%.
recent: Over the past month, GOP shares rose about 10.6%, reaching a 52-week high of $45.00 on May 6, 2026. The fund paid a dividend of $0.25023 per share on December 29, 2025, and has a trailing dividend yield of 0.57%. No major news or earnings events were reported in the last 30 days.
